channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Wall Street just endorsed Jensen Huang's 'big concept' for AI. What now?
item.description: The first three-plus years of the AI build-out have been funded by record amounts of equity and debt issued by leading tech companies. Nvidia has a new idea.

item.title: U.S. oil rises above $83 a barrel as Iran says Strait of Hormuz won't open until conditions are met
item.description: U.S. oil had risen as much as 3% earlier in the day after President Donald Trump demanded that Iran pay reparations to the U.S.

item.title: Democrats clash again in Minnesota and Wisconsin primaries as big midterm races take shape
item.description: In Minnesota, progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and moderate Democratic Rep. Angie Craig are competing for the nomination to succeed the retiring Sen. Tina Smith.

item.title: S&P 500 falls into the red as unraveling Iran situation overhangs market: Live updates
item.description: Investors weighed signs of progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz against doubts that the U.S. and Iran can reach a broader resolution to the conflict.

item.title: Pakistan signals progress on U.S.-Iran deal as Washington and Tehran trade reparation demands
item.description: Washington and Tehran remain far apart even as both sides talked of winding down regional hostilities.

item.title: SpaceX shares can more than double, Morgan Stanley says. The bull thesis isn't based on space business
item.description: SpaceX has worked to become a bigger player in AI by acquiring startup Cursor, and that should add considerable value to its shares, Morgan Stanley says.

item.title: Target appoints its first chief AI officer as big retailers bet on AI
item.description: Target announced its first-ever chief artificial intelligence officer on Tuesday as retailers race to take advantage of the AI boom.

item.title: Why JPMorgan is investing big in the 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: JPMorgan is making a nine-figure bet as the Olympics Games' first-ever global banking partner.

item.title: Intel upsizes stock offering to $20 billion at $95 per share as AI demand accelerates
item.description: Technology giants have shelled out trillions to support insatiable AI demand and the infrastructure buildout.

item.title: Polymarket makes moves to get house in order before expected boom times for prediction markets this fall
item.description: The marketing changes come amid an investigation by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission into the company's promotional practices.

item.title: Parents could put pretax paycheck money into Trump Accounts, with employers matching, Treasury says
item.description: The U.S. Department of the Treasury issued guidance that could allow parents to make pretax contributions to a child's Trump Account directly from their paycheck.

item.title: Interest rates may stay higher for longer. What that means for consumers
item.description: Any move toward higher rates would increase borrowing costs for consumers at a time when affordability pressures are already mounting.

item.title: Credit card debt climbs to $1.26 trillion as ‘K-shaped’ divide persists, New York Fed research finds
item.description: Credit card balances are ticking higher mid-way through the year, according to a new report on household debt from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

item.title: Baby products company Frida is expanding into kids’ personal care
item.description: Baby products company Frida is launching a new category of personal care items for kids, tapping into a growing market and largely untapped space.

item.title: Zelenskyy warns Putin is preparing for escalation by bringing in North Korean military equipment
item.description: His comments come shortly after deadly Russian attacks on cities across Ukraine overnight.

item.title: One big question remains for the bull market, says Bank of America
item.description: Stocks have been able to take almost all of the curve balls thrown their way without a hitch.

item.title: Boeing jet deliveries drop 17% in July
item.description: Boeing also booked 30 new orders after adjusting for cancellations in July, which include a handful of orders announced during a subdued Farnborough Airshow.

item.title: Ukraine war sparked race for countries to build spy satellites, space-tech CEO says
item.description: Governments are ramping up satellite capabilities as space intelligence becomes increasingly critical to modern warfare.

item.title: Trump signs executive order calling for fewer childhood vaccines, falsely linking shots to autism
item.description: The order builds on the Trump administration's efforts to reshape the childhood shot schedule under HHS Secretary RFK Jr., a longtime vaccine skeptic.

item.title: Vietnam’s VinSpace signs deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX to launch its first satellites in 2027
item.description: VinSpace, part of Vietnam's Vingroup conglomerate, said in April that it planned to develop and launch its first satellites in 2027.

item.title: We're exiting our position in an industrial stock to make room for a new AI play
item.description: The company's disappointing quarter last month put the stock on the chopping block.

item.title: See if you qualify for Equifax's $2.2 million settlement and learn how to dispute credit report errors
item.description: Equifax was accused of duplicating negative items on credit reports, lowering credit scores and costing consumers access to mortgages, loans and more.

item.title: U.S. judge ends graft case against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani
item.description: A U.S. federal judge has approved the Department of Justice's decision to dismiss the criminal probe against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani on graft charges.

item.title: FIFA World Cup 'will never be as profitable' if Infantino is ousted, Trump warns amid global soccer revolt
item.description: President Gianni Infantino pushed FIFA's commercialization drive, which culminated in the largest, most profitable World Cup on record

item.title: Hotel giant says ‘growing middle class’ boosted hotel demand despite Middle East hit
item.description: IHG reported higher first-half profit as U.S. demand accelerated and Middle East disruption weighed on travel.

item.title: OpenAI wraps $7 billion share sale ahead of potential IPO
item.description: OpenAI's tender offer has been in the works since the company closed its record-breaking $122 billion funding round in March.

item.title: My 401(k) fully vests this month—why my latest work anniversary is worth thousands
item.description: Many companies contribute to employee retirement accounts, but depending on your firm's rules you may forfeit some or all of it if you leave.

item.title: Eli Lilly takes weight-loss pill battle global with first Foundayo approval in Europe
item.description: Lilly's Foundayo wins U.K. approval, taking its weight-loss pill battle with Novo Nordisk's Wegovy beyond the U.S. market.

item.title: Hormuz deadlock: Where oil prices could head next as prospects for an imminent deal fade
item.description: Oil traders keep clinging to hope that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen. That won't last forever.

item.title: Trump Media posts $238 million second-quarter loss as crypto declines
item.description: TMTG said it has signed more than 10 customer agreements for Truth API, the service offering faster access to President Donald Trump's posts.
